readmeAppend:
## ORT nested notices supplement

`native/ort-nested/index.json` records a bounded, incomplete supplement for fixed ORT nested notice evidence (root ids 30-56 plus child-only ids 101-104). It selects original notice text copies for the recorded known subset and records explicit unselections where the supplied mapping is test/tool/generic or not bound to retained code. This is technical notice delivery only; it does not assert full final composition, retained-code applicability, or W3/P4/legal approval.

The mp11 README/header excerpts are retained as copyright/license declaration evidence only; the complete BSL text remains the existing root asset at `asio-asio-1-24-0-observed-build/LICENSE_1_0.txt`. The upstream JSON embedded-attributions document is preserved with its CC0 declaration. GPL/Apache/BSD texts mapped by `.reuse/dep5` to JSON tests/tools are not copied merely because they appear in the archive, and fixed ORT source has JSON tests OFF. KleidiAI evidence uses the Apache notice plus byte-bound raw Apache SPDX copyright declarations; the generic BSD root text is not treated as proof of retained BSD code. Eigen entries are fixed-ORT nested evidence and are not merged with historical Sherpa Eigen notices. Source-only clog/utf8_range paths are not declared finally present from archive/header install lists alone, nor universally absent from grep. Parent mechanical byte/SHA/provenance binding, builds and negative checks remain required; no execution result is claimed here.
